description: This file defines the `SocketConnectionFactory` class responsible for creating and managing socket connections asynchronously within the Orleans framework. It includes connection setup, socket options configuration, and exception handling related to socket connections. It also defines a `SocketConnectionException` for connection failure scenarios.

classes.name: SocketConnectionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating socket-based network connections with custom configurations and error handling.

classes.name: SocketConnectionException
classes.description: Exception thrown when a socket connection fails, compatible with Orleans exception handling.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously instantiates and connects a socket to the specified endpoint, returning a `ConnectionContext`.

methods.name: SingleUseSocketAsyncEventArgs.OnCompleted
methods.description: Overridden method invoked when socket async operation completes, signaling the associated task.

methods.name: SocketConnectionException's constructors
methods.description: Constructors to create exceptions with message, inner exception, or serialization info.
